Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner mishandled the disambiguation of “Ghar Ki Rani” by inventing an unsupported “2007” canonical date based on a flawed “first-listed IMDb Release Info” criterion, despite sources showing 1940 (Wikipedia) and 1945 (IMDb). This unsupported assumption ignored authoritative data and reversed the correct chronology, leading to the wrong conclusion that Heaven Help Us (1985) was released earlier.
